about_the_game:
🧬 Boot Up. Deploy. Contain. Adapt.

Phantom Containment is a fusion of survival horror, RPG, and tactical extraction gameplay.
You are an advanced synthetic operative deployed by a private containment task force to neutralize paranormal threats worldwide — from haunted houses and cryptid-infested forests to cursed ruins and unstable dimensional rifts.

Every contract is a high-risk operation. Install your loadout chips, calibrate your systems, and deploy into hostile zones to identify, counter, and contain anomalies ranging from rogue spirits to demonic entities — or worse. Whether you adapt or overheat, survive or get scrapped… is up to you.

🔥 No Story? No Problem. It’s You vs the Unknown.

There’s no linear campaign. Only contracts that matter.

You’ll receive missions from competing paranormal factions, each offering unique upgrades and objectives. Briefings outline threat classes, environmental hazards, and mission conditions. Accept your deployment, configure your chip loadout, and enter dynamically generated encounters where no two runs are ever the same.

🚨 Core Features

🛡️ High-Tech HQ Base

Command your operations from a futuristic hub where you:

  • Upgrade your android shell and install new modules.

  • Forge weapons, enhance systems, and cultivate synthetic healing flora.

  • Display your rarest relics, corrupted chips, and anomaly trophies in a collector’s containment vault that evolves with your journey.

🔎 Mission-Based Deployments

Contracts send you into unpredictable, procedural missions:

  • Purge cursed locations.

  • Hunt cryptids.

  • Retrieve volatile artifacts.

  • Survive full-on supernatural incursions.

Each operation demands sharp loadout planning and in-the-moment adaptability.

⚔️ Relic Arsenal & Adaptive Gear

The hunt never ends. Collect and master over 400 relic artifact weapons:

  • Each relic carries unique powers, curses, and elemental effects, making every find a potential game-changer.

  • Relics can be purified, corrupted, or empowered, evolving them into new forms of devastating or unstable power.

  • Pair relics with your high-tech equipment — from plasma rifles and spectral detectors to enchanted blades and tactical drones.

  • Upgrade both relics and modern gear across uncommon, rare, epic, and legendary tiers through a deep customization system.

Your arsenal isn’t just tools. It’s a collection of history, myth, and nightmares — weaponized.

💽 Chip-Based Progression — No HP. No Stamina. No Limits.

You don’t bleed. You don’t tire. You are a programmable platform.

  • Core Integrity replaces health — repaired with nanite gels or auto-repair modules.

  • System Heat replaces stamina — overexertion risks thermal overload.

  • Chip Modules define your build — combat, mobility, support, or sensor chips alter how you fight and survive.

  • System Corruption from demonic exposure can disable modules or hijack your HUD until purged.

Your chips shape how you play. Your relics define what you fight with.

🧪 Grow & Brew Synthetic Recovery Tools

Cultivate programmable herbs and compounds inside grow rooms. Brew nanite-infused mixtures to repair integrity, purge corruption, or temporarily boost resistances. Vital when missions lean heavy into demonic or cursed anomalies.

👻 Multiple Anomaly Classes

Face four distinct paranormal threat types, each requiring unique strategies:

  • Ghosts — unseen, elusive, psychological threats.

  • Demons — corruptive, relentless, power-driven forces.

  • Cryptids — physical predators with unpredictable patterns.

  • Cursed Objects — unstable relics that twist reality itself.

Identify, adapt, and overcome — or risk losing everything.

⚖️ Faction-Based Alignment System

Align yourself with rival paranormal factions, each with:

  • Unique relic unlocks.

  • Specialized chip upgrades.

  • Diverging progression trees.

But beware: loyalty to one faction locks you out of others. Your allegiances shape your arsenal, your tactics, and your legacy.

🏆 Collector’s Trophy & Containment Room

Your containment vault is more than storage — it’s a chronicle of your journey.

  • Showcase empowered relics, corrupted chips, cursed artifacts, and anomaly samples.

  • Every relic has a history. Every trophy tells a story.

  • Completionists and collectors can aim to obtain the full 400+ relic arsenal — a pursuit as dangerous as it is rewarding.

🌍 A World Where Every Contract Is Your Code

Whether solo or with a tactical squad, Phantom Containment thrives on mechanical mastery, player choice, and evolving challenges. Missions reshape themselves around your tactics, your chips, and your relic collection.

You’re not a hero.
You’re not even human.
You’re a weapon — calibrated to contain what others run from.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of supernatural horror, including ghosts, demons, possessions, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter violence, use weapons to defeat enemies, and may see blood effects. Themes of corruption and dark rituals are present, which may be disturbing to some audiences.

detailed_description:
🧬 JOIN EARLY. EARN WHAT OTHERS NEVER WILL — TIME-LIMITED GEAR ROTATES WITH EACH MAJOR PATCH!

Join Phantom Containment during Early Access to collect exclusive prototype weapons, armor mods, and experimental enchantments — only available for a limited time.

With each major patch, the current wave of limited-rarity items will rotate out permanently and be replaced with new ones. These items will be fully removed from the game when we reach 1.0 — never to return.

Whether you hunt alone or with a team, Early Access operatives can leave their mark by collecting rare gear that proves you were there before the true containment protocols began.

Gear up. Adapt. Survive. Only the earliest survive with legacy gear in hand.


Note from the Developer

Once development on Phantom Containment officially concludes, and End of Life is announced the game will be opened up to the community. Modders will have full access and support to extend, tweak, or transform the game however they like.

There will be no server shutdowns. No kill-switches. Just a growing sandbox for the horror community to thrive.

I’ve been in your shoes—losing access to games I paid for simply because the devs decided they were done. That sucks, and I don’t want that to happen with Phantom Containment.

So when I eventually EoL the game , I won’t just walk away—I’ll leave behind the tools, mod support, and everything needed so you and the community can keep the world alive, build your own stories, and enjoy the game on your terms.


Massive Bestiary of the Unknown

👁️ 1,800+ Entities Planned — Endless Horrors to Hunt

Phantom Containment is being built to deliver the largest catalog of paranormal threats in the genre.
Over 1,800 ghosts, demons, cryptids, deities, and folklore legends are planned — ensuring fresh hunts, escalating danger, and an ever-evolving universe of fear.

📚 Grounded in Real Legends

Every entity is shaped by authentic lore, sightings, mythology, and historical records — never randomly made up.

🧩 No filler.
📖 Every creature is researched.
🕯️ Every nightmare is rooted in reality.

🔬 Investigation Meets Myth

Each supernatural threat includes:

• Documented origins & credible background
• Unique behaviors tied to real myths
• Cultural storytelling from around the world

You’re not just hunting monsters…
You’re uncovering what humanity fears most.
